title: A chain build plans round 0 in one conversation and writes its copy draft in five parts
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The chain's planner run has no --parallel-pages, keeps the visual review and no whole kit in its first message.
The copy draft's parts are a value the writer takes, below its ceiling.

tests: the chain's planner run plans its first draft in one conversation, with the visual review, reading the kit by tools
the copy step's first draft is written in parts the writer takes, below its ceiling
